page.overview:
Who is Abigail (Mutant)?

Manifestation of the new mutant was registered by the Cerebro on Krakoa nation, and they also registered the earthquake.

Believing that the earthquake was caused by the new mutant who was now most likely in danger, the New Mutants were dispatched in order to protect her from an expected human on mutant hate crime resultant of the calamity.

The islanders indeed attacked the New Mutants, but only because they thought the team was planning to kidnap Abigail; her mother and all of the islanders were actually protecting the girl and have no intent to harm her.

Warpath could see that the people were protecting their own and released the girl back into her family's care. As an extension of good will, he had Magik and their students continue helping with relief efforts. They also offered Abigail sanctuary on Krakoa in case she ever needed it.
